body:
scan.One returns the first row and does not test for a second; exec.One returns ErrMultipleRows for a bound query matching more than one row. Use the API whose contract fits, or use scan.All and check the length when asserting uniqueness. Do not add LIMIT 1 to hide a duplicate when uniqueness is the requirement.

Evidence: ds:block?id=reader-cardinality-332zvda7; ds:block?id=bound-one-x39s9kka. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: One has two cardinality contracts
